Questions 9-12 refer to the following email.
Dear Mr. Elias, as Assistant Director of the Administrative Department, I would like
to request permission to attend a business conference in Los Angeles next month.
I will need to be away for a week, but the information I hope to obtain at the event
will be beneficial for the company.
The conference is about reorganizing for maximum efficiency, and the material could be applied
to our efforts in developing a better office system.
I'm especially interested in using cutting edge technology to make our office more progressive.
This will help us meet the standards that many companies now have.
There are other issues I can think of but won't mention at this time.
Of course, your recommendations and suggestions are most welcome.
You probably have insights that I haven't thought of yet.
I hope the company will provide me with the support I need to attend this conference.
Gail
Question 13 refers to the following article.
The Almaca College Board of Governors will be meeting at the end of the month to discuss
recent concerns.
Among the issues expected to be raised are plans to renovate old buildings and whether
or not to increase tuition fees this year.
